_note: Illustrative, simplified data inspired by the Lebanon Mountain Trail (LMT) for an academic assignment. Distances, elevations, conditions and alerts are approximate or simulated. Always check lebanontrail.org and official advisories before hiking.

sections.name: Andqet to Qbayat
sections.highlights: Akkar oak forests and the first trail marker of the LMT

sections.name: Qbayat to Akkar el Atika
sections.highlights: Remote juniper slopes with wide views over Akkar

sections.name: Sir ed-Danniyeh to Ehden
sections.highlights: High plateau crossing toward the Horsh Ehden reserve

sections.name: Ehden to Bcharre (Kadisha rim)
sections.highlights: Kadisha Valley monasteries and views of the Cedars of God area

sections.name: Tannourine to Aaqoura
sections.highlights: Tannourine cedar forest and limestone canyons

sections.name: Afqa to Baskinta
sections.highlights: Afqa grotto spring and the Baskinta literary trail

sections.name: Baskinta to Zaarour
sections.highlights: Gentle orchards and pine forest, good for beginners

sections.name: Falougha to Ain Zhalta
sections.highlights: Pine woods descending to the Ain Zhalta cedar entrance

sections.name: Barouk to Niha (Shouf Cedar Reserve)
sections.highlights: Ridge walk through the largest cedar reserve in Lebanon

sections.name: Niha to Jezzine
sections.highlights: Pine forests above Jezzine and its waterfall

sections.name: Jezzine to Kfar Houne
sections.highlights: Short scenic walk through stone villages

sections.name: Rashaya el Foukhar to Marjayoun
sections.highlights: Pottery village of Rashaya el Foukhar and the southern end of the trail

S02.text: Simulated alert: trail markers damaged after storms between km 9 and 12; GPS track required.

S03.text: Simulated alert: high plateau crossing is impassable when snow covers the trail (typically December to April).

S09.text: Simulated alert: reserve entry fee and ranger check-in required at the Barouk gate.

S12.text: Simulated alert: section temporarily closed by authorities; do not attempt until the closure is lifted.
